Genuine Friending Core event-wall safety responses, produced through Router::dispatch and the
production response serializer by tests/dates_wall_storage_test.php on an owned disposable
replica set. The manifest pins every body, the capture driver and all loaded Core source bytes.
The complete corpus is retained so it can be compared byte-for-byte with the native consumer.
Only admin-*.json bodies are Webadmin responses; wall-*.json bodies use the member envelope.
No production identity, content, credential or private user media is present.
